Set the number of Julia threads (superseded by lm_start())

julia_threads.Rd

Sets JULIA_NUM_THREADS for the Julia process started next. Superseded: prefer lm_start(threads = n), which also starts the process. If Julia is already running the call warns, because the thread count of a running process cannot change.

Usage

julia_threads(n = "auto")

Arguments

n

Number of threads (a positive integer), or "auto".

Value

n, invisibly.

See also

lm_start()

Examples

# the thread count is read when Julia starts; set it before the first fit
old <- Sys.getenv("JULIA_NUM_THREADS")
julia_threads(4)
Sys.getenv("JULIA_NUM_THREADS")
#> [1] "4"
Sys.setenv(JULIA_NUM_THREADS = old)   # restore
